text:
sre-oncall: FYI incident - ingress janitor queue backlog in eu-west-1 started ~08:10 UTC, seeing elevated 503s for short-tail requests. Investigating. /cc @channel

ops-bot: [ALERT] ingress-janitor-queue-length > 30k (eu-west-1) - auto-scaling triggered

maria: Noted - I'm looking at the janitor pod logs. Can anyone confirm if the new GC flags from last deploy landed on the janitor image?

ashwin: I rolled a minor image update at 07:58 but it was only config toggles. No GC flags. Checking queue consumer lag now.

emily: Customer impact: some hosted API calls (short context) returning 503s and slow tail latency for dedicated customers in eu-west-1. Internal metric: request success rate down ~7% for the region.

platform-eng: Routing fallback enabled to us-east-1 for affected tenants to reduce customer errors. Metrics show fallthrough requests up ~4k rps.

maria: Log sample from janitor (truncated):
```
2026-02-18T08:11:23Z ERROR consumer: failed to process eviction batch: context deadline exceeded
2026-02-18T08:11:24Z WARN backlog: queue length=32412 inflight=1024
2026-02-18T08:11:25Z ERROR mempool: out-of-slab reallocation retry=3
```

ashwin: Confirmed root cause signal: consumer threads are stuck in a synchronous DB compaction call introduced by a migration we shipped yesterday. That compaction blocks eviction workers and increases queue backlog.

sre-oncall: Immediate mitigations applied: 1) scaled janitor workers +30% across eu-west autoset, 2) toggled migration flag to noop for compaction (hotfix), 3) enabled cross-region fallback as noted. Early numbers show queue length halving.

maria: Rollback command used:
```
kubectl set env deployment/janitor-service MIGRATION_COMPACT=false -n infra-eu-west
kubectl rollout restart deployment/janitor-service -n infra-eu-west
```

ops-bot: [ACTION] Auto-scale completed at 08:16 UTC (added 12 pods).

emily: Customer comms: drafting short status page update and support templated message. ETA for first public update 08:30 UTC: https://status.redwood.infra/incidents/1719995000 (internal preview)

platform-eng: Current status: partial mitigation in place. Observed 503 rate dropped from 7% -> 1.2% over 10m. Some tail latency still elevated due to backlog drains.

ashwin: Plan: keep migration flag disabled, monitor for 1 hour. If stable, schedule a safe migration window with throttled compaction and a canary rollout.

sre-oncall: Customer impact summary (short): - Affected region: eu-west-1 - Symptoms: intermittent 503 and elevated latency for short-context requests - Mitigation: scaled workers, disabled compaction, cross-region routing fallback - Current ETA to normal (<0.5% errors): ~20-40 minutes barring regressions

maria: Assigning postmortem owner: @ashwin - please own the follow-up, RCA, and remediation plan. Add the migration flag check to preflight for future deploys.

ashwin: Acknowledged. Will open the incident PR with timeline, logs, and remediation items. Target for incident report: EOD tomorrow.

emily: I'll coordinate customer notifications and update the status page at 08:30 and again at 09:00 if needed.

sre-oncall: Thanks all. If anything regresses ping here and @sre-oncall will escalate. Closing the incident channel thread once backlog fully drains and error rate stabilizes <0.5%.

ops-bot: [RESOURCES] Runbook link: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/ingress-janitor-queue.md | Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/ingress-janitor-eu-west?orgId=1
